skills.name: check_email_breaches
skills.description: Check whether an email address appears in the XposedOrNot index of known public data breaches. Returns the list of breach names only. Never returns passwords.

skills.name: get_breach_analytics
skills.description: Get detailed breach analytics for an email address: risk score, breach timeline, exposed data categories, and password risk.

skills.name: list_breaches
skills.description: List or filter indexed breaches by domain or breach ID. Accepts an optional limit (default 25, maximum 100). The full exposure description is returned only for a single breach_id lookup; filtered and unfiltered lists return compact fields.

skills.name: domain_breach_summary
skills.description: Get an aggregate breach summary for a domain, including the number of breaches, affected email accounts, pastes, and the most recent breach date. Returns only counts, not individual email addresses.

skills.name: get_breach_metrics
skills.description: Get system-wide breach statistics: total breaches and records indexed, breaches per year and industry, the largest and most recent breaches, and when the latest breach was added.

skills.name: get_recent_breaches
skills.description: Get the latest data breach news and recently added breaches tracked by XposedOrNot.
